normative_meaning: Restored Liquidity spec defines aggressive-buy notional / displayed ask capacity and aggressive-sell notional / displayed bid capacity. Flow has different mechanical significance under shallow vs deep displayed capacity; this is an effect-conditioning relationship, not a confidence multiplier.
Touch fill/replenishment/withdrawal/retreat explains how displayed liquidity was disposed while aggressive flow executed.
Compare actual executed flow with displayed-book mutation, turnover, and touch/full-book imbalance disagreement.
Arrival intensity × mean trade notional separates event frequency from economic event size; many-small and few-large activity are distinct.
OI, basis and liquidation state contextualize aggressive flow without assigning leverage causality.
Local flow distinguishes a correlated price move with local participation from one with little local execution imbalance.
Local signed flow contextualizes member/cohort return distribution and breadth.

Compare touch imbalance with full-depth imbalance, touch-depth divergence with whole-book notional divergence, and touch geometry with deeper-book structure. Resolution disagreement is itself measurable; it is not spoof/loaded classification.
Aggregate removals/turnover plus touch-level trade attribution distinguish execution, withdrawal, retreat, replenishment and redistribution.
Book mutation under ordinary arrivals differs from mutation during clustered arrival intensity.
Morphology describes arrangement; depthflow describes mutation. Shape change plus turnover/flow describes how structure is moving.
Relationship changes under unusual book turnover/imbalance differ from the same price dependence under ordinary microstructure.
Lag changes can be interpreted alongside turnover, resolution gap, withdrawal/replenishment; never convert precedence into causality.

Restored Liquidity spec explicitly relates buy arrival intensity to displayed ask capacity and sell arrival intensity to displayed bid capacity (lambda_buy/D_ask, lambda_sell/D_bid or analogous rate-normalized forms).
Spread/depth state contextualizes lag seconds, lag gain and lag stability; liquidity may alter repricing speed.
Price dependence/movement can be contextualized by touch depth, depth divergence, spread divergence, Liquidity SNR and book-shape novelty; Liquidity does not decide what the relationship implies.

Liquidity supplies the resulting displayed touch state; Toxicity supplies attributed fill, withdrawal, replenishment or retreat mechanism. Useful joint states include cancellation+falling depth, cancellation+replenishment, fills+falling depth, and retreat+stable aggregate depth. Neither assigns intent.

Price/cross-sectional movement can be contextualized by touch depth, depth divergence, spread divergence, Liquidity SNR and book-shape novelty. The same return under ordinary vs unusual liquidity is mechanically different.
Arrival clustering combined with replenishment/withdrawal/retreat distinguishes event density from liquidity disposition.
Compare event-process excitation changes with price-path lag changes; neither establishes the other.
Price-path coupling and event-process excitation are separate dependence structures.
Liquidation events require distinct marks if modeled; compare liquidation clustering with OI/liquidation state.
Correlation measures dependence at a defined alignment; lead-lag measures how dependence changes with alignment.
Pair/cohort dependence complements breadth, return dispersion and median movement.
For explicit related markets, price dependence complements basis, return gap, OI and liquidation state.
Cross-sectional state may motivate explicit pair analysis but must not silently pick the leader/reference.
Spot/perpetual/index lag complements basis/OI/liquidation geometry; it is not price discovery by itself.
Cohort breadth/dispersion can be compared with OI, basis and liquidation distributions in explicit derivative cohorts.
Volume-clock economic throughput complements signed executed flow; activity and direction are separate.

Executed volume/notional rate is interpreted alongside depth ratio, depth-divergence velocity, spread divergence and shape-change distance. Liquidity supplies state/geometry; the volume-clock signal supplies execution activity.
Volume-clock activity with turnover/book mutation distinguishes tape throughput from displayed-book change.
Activity and return combined with replenishment/withdrawal/retreat describe how the touch responds.
Completed economic throughput and event-arrival intensity separate event count dynamics from trade size.
Local activity/return is interpreted against explicit cohort breadth and dispersion.
Local activity state contextualizes changing pair/cohort price dependence.
Book arrangement and absolute executable capacity answer different questions; shape is not capacity.
Book arrangement and its mutation/turnover jointly describe structural evolution.
Touch disposition can explain whether an observed shape change came with fills, replenishment, withdrawal or retreat.
Compare dimensionless morphology state/change to its own causal historical context in an Advisor; raw shape is not a regime label.
Legacy compatibility source duplicates canonical liquidity facts; migrate consumers to liquidity.
Legacy compatibility source duplicates canonical depthflow facts; migrate consumers to depthflow.
Legacy compatibility source duplicates canonical executed-flow facts; do not grow new exhaust dependencies.
